name: 48076 · Southfield, MI
findings: ZIP 48076 (Southfield) has 230 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48076 (Southfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48076 (Southfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 62 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
